# Mini release (test fixture)

A two-paper release in the layout of the published one, used by the derive tests.

## Sources of the correspondence table

`taxonomy_correspondence.source_ref` names its sources by key.

| Key | Vocabulary | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Mehr2020 | XDL | Mehr et al., Science (2020), doi:10.1/xdl. Page numbers refer to the accepted manuscript |
| Bai2024, Bai2024_SI | OntoLab / SAREF (module types only) | Bai et al., Journal B (2024), doi:10.1/saref, and its supplementary information |
| Gottstein2026 | Orchestration levels | Gottstein et al., Journal G (2026), doi:10.1/gott |

The autonomy categories are those of a later table, doi:10.1/other.
